text.searchTermsNote: Healthcare search terms are broad ("healthcare solution providers," "healthcare software companies"). Adding negative keywords for software and practice-startup searches would focus spend on real estate intent.
text.budgetNote: Conferences ($104K) and videography ($20K) are budgeted in November and December, so year-end utilization depends on those landing.
text.fatigueNote: No sign of fatigue: these ads' click-through rates rose over the year as budgets narrowed to tighter audiences. Refresh on frequency (more than about 4 impressions per person per month) rather than on a calendar.
bestPractices: Lead with a point of view on cost and risk
Cost-certainty statements ("The lowest number rarely survives delivery.") average 1.85% click-through vs 1.05% for brand promises and 0.54% for direct asks.
Keep Boldt out of the headline
Headlines that name Boldt average 0.86% vs 1.55% without; the logo and page name already carry the brand.
Specific, complete-sentence headlines average 1.62% vs 1.07% for 6 words or fewer, and cost about half as much per conversion.
Earn the click before asking for a meeting
"Schedule a meeting" and "Contact our experts" average 0.54% at $9.96 per click. Save direct asks for retargeting.
Match every high-click ad with a converting page
Cost-certainty ads drew 1,021 clicks and no conversions; fix the landing page before adding budget.
Use document ads for retargeting only
Document lead gen costs $1,250 per conversion vs $498 for image ads, with a 0.25% click-through rate.
Financing and ownership headlines average 0.71% at $7.33 per click. State the outcome (for example, capital freed or rent avoided) rather than the product name.
Test in pairs, judge at 10,000 impressions
Run 2 to 3 headlines per theme and wait for 10,000 impressions each before calling a winner.

exec.prepared: Draft through October 28. The final October report posts November 1.
exec.headline: October held MQL volume close to recent months while SQLs kept running well ahead of last year. Through October 28, healthcare marketing produced 23 new MQLs, and year-to-date SQLs (33 through September) are up 57% on 2025.

sections.title: Results
sections.body: Healthcare marketing produced 23 new MQLs through October 28, on pace for about 25 by month end against a monthly goal of 37. Year to date, MQLs total 256, which is 69% of the conservative goal. SQLs are the strongest signal: 33 from January through September versus 21 in the same months of 2025, and MQL-to-SQL conversion has doubled to 14.2%.

sections.title: What went well
bullets: Lead quality improved. Cost per SQL is $3,453 this year, down from $7,619 in 2025.
Cost-certainty messaging is our strongest LinkedIn theme at a 1.85% click-through rate. Healthcare image ads overall rose from 1.19% to 1.94% click-through since July.
Healthcare website traffic held steady at 1,275 sessions through October 27, versus 1,379 for all of September, and 150 HubSpot companies visited the site.
Ernest Health visited the site after seeing our LinkedIn ads and became an MQL on October 26.

sections.title: Where we are focused
bullets: MQL volume trails last year: 233 from January through September versus 277 in 2025, down 16%. That lifts cost per MQL to $445 from $390.
LinkedIn is reaching too many clinical roles. 38% of healthcare impressions went to clinical titles and 4% to real estate, facilities and development roles, so targeting is being tightened.
The cost-certainty landing page converts few visitors despite strong ad clicks. The page is being reworked.

sections.title: Budget
sections.body: Healthcare and shared marketing spend is $138K, 68% of the budget to date. LinkedIn lead generation was paused in October by plan, leaving about $4,850 of the month's LinkedIn budget available. Conferences ($104K) and videography ($20K) are scheduled for November and December.
